description: Source file implementing the CameraController actor for managing camera and microphone access, capturing photos and videos, configuring device selection, handling errors, and exporting media, primarily for iOS applications.

classes.name: PhotoCaptureDelegate
classes.description: Handles photo capture delegate callback, managing asynchronous data retrieval, error handling, and ensuring single callback execution.

classes.name: MovieFileDelegate
classes.description: Handles recording delegate callback for video capture, managing completion and error handling.

methods.name: snap
methods.description: Captures a photo with specified parameters asynchronously and returns image data formatted as specified.

methods.name: clip
methods.description: Records a video clip with given parameters, transcodes and encodes it, then returns media info.

methods.name: listDevices
methods.description: Enumerates available camera devices with their info.
